evidence_items.explanation: The survey reports a gap between enterprise ambitions and deployment, including limited integration and trust concerns. It does not isolate hallucinations as the cause or establish a lasting market-wide disappointment.

The study supports reliability as a continuing obstacle and also documents deployed systems using controls to manage it. Its abstract does not establish representative customer disappointment or precise fieldwork dates.

The report puts current production adoption at 57.3% among surveyed practitioners, providing contrary context to an undifferentiated failure narrative. Adoption does not establish satisfaction, and this vendor-associated sample cannot represent all agent customers.
